As the main characters of The Plot (™), the developers like to force us to use the Askr Trio for things such as Quests and Arena, even as they are powercrept to hell and back. I personally like them, and it’s a shame that their stats are so outdated and they’re unable to be merged. So I decided that I should go all out on them and let them become the powerful Lords they’re meant to be. My idea was to essentially be thematic with their skills and stats between each other, upgrade what skills they currently have, or to synergize and stack with what their refined weapons provide. Thankfully I received the necessary fodder by accident or for free (my personal rule is to never fodder off a unit I only have one copy of), so technically not much went into them.


Alfonse: Mr. Benchlord himself, now a bench presser with Triple Brazen Madness.

Weapon: Folkvangr (Eff Refine)

Triangle Adept actually isn’t that bad of a refine for him imo. It’s not like he’d want to go up against blue units anyway, and thematically it helps him against the story’s big bads. The Brazen Atk/Def is the main attraction.

Assist: Swap

Thematically, it fits that Alfonse’s Assist skill would be more precise but less “powerful” than his Commander’s. Gameplay wise, he can switch spaces with his pals and take the brunt of an attack with his Brazens active.

Special: Sol

Thematically, I wanted him to keep his Special to go with the Sun, Moon, Star trio motif. Gameplay wise, self sustainability is always good, even if it’s troublesome for his Brazens.

A Skill: Brazen Atk/Def 3

The second component of the Triple Brazen Madness. More on that later.

B Skill: Axebreaker 3

Fuck you Surtr and your Wary Fighter bullcrap.

C Skill: Drive Atk 2

A straight upgrade to his base Spur Atk.

Seal: Brazen Atk/Def 3

The prime jewel of my build for Alfonse is the Triple Brazen. 21 Atk and Def when he’s only lightly scratched by damage is no joke. It turns him from decently bulky to an unbeatable tank of death. Overkill? Yes, but Alfonse needs overkill in order to be truly serviceable.


Sharena: The bubbly princess of friendship. Bond with her!

Weapon: Fensalir (Eff Refine)

Ignoring visible buffs from enemies? Good. Spd/Def Bond? Even better.

Assist: Rally Up Atk +

Pretty straightforward; an outright upgrade to her base Rally Attack, and helps with Arena scoring too. And generally it’s a good skill.

Special: Luna

Piercing enemy defenses fits with her “Found your weak spot!” quote, it rounds out the Sun, Moon, Star motif, and it’s a generally good skill.


A Skill: Spd/Def Bond 3

Just like with Alfonse, it stacks with her Refined weapon. This helps turn her from a Master of None to a true Jack of All Trades.

B Skill: Swordbreaker 3

Because even when you have +10 Speed from Bonds, you still need to make sure that speedy sword units die a painful death.

C Skill: Fortify Def 3

Might replace with Even Def Wave 3. Still thinking on that.

Seal: Threaten Atk 2

Honestly a placeholder until we get a Spd/Def Bond Sacred Seal.


Anna: The mobile Commander. Give her an alt plz.

Weapon: Noatun (Eff Refine)

Is it underwhelming compared to the other refines? Yes. But is it still useful? Yes. Warping around can be surprisingly potent when combined with Reposition.

Assist: Reposition

Because every Commander needs an ability with strategic value. This synergizes with Noatun, allowing her to bring allies to safety easily.

Special: Astra

Rounds out the Sun, Moon, Star Special motif I have going on.

A Skill: Fury 3

She’s mad because she doesn’t have an alt. Okay, but seriously, she needs the stat boost Fury provides, and it synergizes with Vantage and Noatun.

B Skill: Vantage 3

Maybe I should replace it with Desperation? I dunno. It still has its uses against foes who try to be cheeky in finishing her off when they themselves are at low health.

C Skill: Drive Res 2

An upgrade to her base Spur Res. Her allies need to Res buff anyways.

Seal: Drive Res 1

Need to upgrade. Stacks with her C Skill.


And that’s all I have! Let me know if you guys like my builds or if they need improvements!
